UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5
FREE END OPEN: drum on dolly rolls in

svg.text: Agitator weldment (shaft, 2 outer + 2 inner ribbons, 14 arms)
Cover weldment (hinged, bag-dump opening, 4 in screw inlet)
PTFE packing 10 sq, 4 rings per box
Discharge valve 4 in TC, 24 V actuator
1. Shaft turns CLOCKWISE seen from the drive end at 40 rpm: outer ribbons carry product to the centre (discharge), inner ribbons to
2. Working volume 6.0 cu ft [170 L]; total 259 L; design batch 131 L = 67 kg at 0.51 kg/L (51 % full).
3. Design torque 358 N·m at 40 rpm, 2 x for starting; drive 1.5 kW via VFD (soft start).
4. Anchor the 4 feet with H4 after levelling: shaft axis level within 1 mm over its length.
5. Free end has no lower cross rail so a 55 gal drum on dolly P1-309 rolls under the valve; keep it clear.
6. Product contact: trough inside, agitator, cover underside, ferrules: 316L, #4 finish, welds ground flush.
7. Lifting: sling the trough under the bowl or lift the whole machine by the top rails at the legs; never by the shaft or cover.
8. Read with P1-301-002 (section and fits), -003 (assembly sequence), -600 (hardware) and E01..E04 (electrical).
